The Idaho Sheriffs Association has strongly opposed the bill, saying sheriffs already cooperate with ICE, but the mandates in this legislation go too far. Bonner County Sheriff Daryl Wheeler wrote that the proposal is “the most egregious Constitutional violation ever faced by Idaho Sheriffs.” Boundary County Sheriff Travis Stolley posted on Facebook “"What matters is that the decision to participate (in the program) — or to step back — should rest with the elected sheriff who answers directly to the citizens of his or her county, not with politicians in Boise who don’t patrol our roads or manage our aging jail."
